title: Sigils (Elements)
description: Sigil = central core of the glyph; defines the element. SVG in viewBox '-50 -50 100 100', stroke in currentColor, no fill unless noted. Reference sigils are auto-vectorized from assets/images/sigils/*.png (render:"fill"); the rest are stylized stroke paths.

sigils.name: Fire
sigils.description: Creates and manipulates flame and heat. One of the four primary tetrad.
sigils.centerHint: Upward triangle with a downward stem and two branch-ticks on the upper sides.

sigils.name: Water
sigils.description: Manipulates, collects, and creates water. One of the four primary tetrad.
sigils.centerHint: Central hooked stroke flanked by a bottom-joined loop (left) and a top-joined loop (right).

sigils.name: Earth
sigils.description: Manipulates (not creates) wood, stone, sand, and soil. The sigil of might; primary tetrad.
sigils.centerHint: Horizontal bar with a stem; inverted triangle below, with two side dots (·▽·).

sigils.name: Wind
sigils.description: Moves and manipulates (not creates) air. The sigil of levitation; primary tetrad.
sigils.centerHint: Central airflow spiral flanked by horizontal gust-dashes on each side.

sigils.name: Light
sigils.description: Fire variant that manifests magic as light.
sigils.centerHint: Square with an inscribed diamond and a cross-stub extending past each edge.

sigils.name: Wind Underfoot
sigils.description: Helps support solid objects suspended in air, like an air platform. Function unclear.
sigils.reference: Sylph Shoes Seal, Pegasus Carriage Spell

sigils.name: Aeriforms
sigils.description: Creates and manipulates (but does not move) air.
sigils.centerHint: Central airflow spiral with radiating gusts/rays on all sides (sustains air).

sigils.name: Whorling Winds
sigils.description: Manipulates air through rotation. Three-sided design may hint at a fire connection.

sigils.name: Crystal
sigils.description: Creates and manipulates crystalline objects.

sigils.name: Repetition
sigils.description: Resets affected objects to their original state, preventing change (e.g. rot, deformation).
sigils.centerHint: Outer ring enclosing a central spiral coil.
sigils.reference: Repetition Seal, Serpent's Bed of Sand

sigils.name: Vision (as sigil)
sigils.description: The vision sign at the center (needs no elemental sigil). Basis of Gathering Shadows and Cloak Spell.

sigils.name: Billowing (as sigil)
sigils.description: The billowing sign at the center converts material into a cloud (Billowing Collection).

sigils.name: Unknown / Forbidden Sigil
sigils.description: Placeholder for unidentified sigils (Beast Repellent center, Forbidden Flames, Scalewolf Curse, etc.).
sigils.centerHint: Unknown — rendered as a neutral mark.

sigils.name: Unburning Flames
sigils.description: Involved in producing heatless flame (phantasmal fireball). Exact function unclear.

sigils.name: Stop
sigils.description: Halts time for affected objects; paired with other sigils, stops specific aspects (e.g. heat).

sigils.name: Bird A
sigils.description: Creates a flying bird-like projection of the seal’s magic.

sigils.name: Bird B
sigils.description: Manifests magic as a bird (more duck-like than Bird A).

sigils.name: Dragon
sigils.description: Manifests magic in the shape of a dragon.

sigils.name: Flower
sigils.description: Manifests magic in the shape of numerous flowers.

sigils.name: Horse
sigils.description: Manifests magic as a horse; can pull loads (practical use).

sigils.name: Owlcat
sigils.description: Likely forms a full owlcat (vs. just the head).

sigils.name: Owlcat Head
sigils.description: Manifests the near-spherical head of a winter-plumage owlcat.

sigils.name: Scalewolf
sigils.description: Manifests magic in the shape of a scalewolf.

sigils.name: Torchstag
sigils.description: Manifests magic in the shape of a torchstag.

sigils.name: Liongoat
sigils.description: Manifests magic in the shape of a liongoat.

sigils.name: Valance Leech
sigils.description: Manifests magic in the shape of a valance leech.

sigils.name: Smoke
sigils.description: Creates and generates smoke (manipulation unconfirmed).

sigils.name: Guidance
sigils.description: Attracts nearby objects matching the spell’s parameters toward the glyph.

sigils.name: Calling
sigils.description: Echoes back a recorded phrase (seen in the Pouch of Calling).
